title: 第2章 天道灭玲珑第3章 禁忌话题
content_zh:
轰！
在七巧玲珑心刚刚形成雏形之中，原先还算平静的天际，立刻就变得汹涌澎湃了，浩瀚天地气氛瞬间压抑下来，一股恐怖的灭世威压震荡在天空之上。
“终于来了么！”
这一幕可谓惊天动地，对道袍神尊，巫神，魔尊这几位星界巨头来说，非常乐意见到，他们大喜。
此时，房玄木等五位天君，亦是对此有所感应，他们望着闭目盘坐，仿佛与外界隔绝的肖恩，脸上忧色更浓。
轰隆！
陡然间，天空响起了一道惊雷，许多人的心随之颤了颤，抬头望向虚空，这一瞬间，头顶上空的天仿佛变了颜色，无尽的雷霆之光如血闪耀。
整个天际风气呼嚎，乾坤荡漾，雷声激烈，如火的怒意焚烧天穹，仿若陷入了灭世的状态。
“有点不妙啊！”
五位天君的目光死死的盯着那天际，天地间无尽雷霆力量不由自主的朝着七彩之心汇聚而去，一时间整个七彩之心都像是被雷光覆盖，犹如汹涌浪潮的孤舟一般，孤立无援！
一时间，天昏地暗，犹如灭世雷霆降临。
无数人既心颤，又不解，为何刚刚接受天地祝贺的七彩之心，此刻却迎来了毁灭！
轰隆！
瞬间，一抹璀璨到极致的血雷之光骤然降临七彩之心，无法抗衡的毁灭意志直接是自虚空镇压而下，血雷过处，虚空不断的震颤，一股惊人的意志之力笼罩开来。
轰咔！
血雷过后，天空之上，那七彩之心直接是被抹除一彩，呈现残缺心形。
“果然！”
诸天各界，响起一道道欣然之声，这一幕，仿若既在意料之中，又在乐见之上。
这些声音，自然是来自各界巨头口中。
天妒之心，天道怎么可能会容许它的存在，而且，这种毁灭，仅仅只是开始而已。

五位天君的目光，却是死死的盯着犹如雕像的肖恩身上的变化。
咔哧！
少年身上，随着天空之上的七彩之心被抹除一彩，那缭绕在他身上的七彩光辉并没有被抹除，而是其中的一道蓝光缓缓的缩回体内。
五大天君默不作声。
轰！轰！轰！轰！
众人只见，天穹连续降临四道毁灭之雷，那六彩之心，一道道彩光崩溃，也可以说是湮灭。
最后，天空之上的那道心形，仅仅只剩下绿，紫两道彩光形成一轮月牙般的弯月。
“七巧齐聚，果真是祸非福！”
道袍神尊对于此事仿佛早有预料，并没有太多波澜，静待毁灭降临。
这便是天妒，就算是玲珑六窍，也不会招来天道毁灭，唯独玲珑七窍，不灭则已，灭则必尽。
所以，此心拥有者，自古至今，从来没有一人能够存活。
各界巨头，均持此意。
轰隆！
两道酝酿已久的毁灭雷光化作灭世血蟒，划破长空，直直向着绿，紫两色弯月劈了下来。
轰隆！
content_en:
boom!
When the Qiqiao Exquisite Heart had just taken shape, the originally calm sky immediately became turbulent. The atmosphere of the vast world was instantly suppressed, and a terrifying world-destroying pressure shook the sky.
"Is it finally here?"
This scene was earth-shattering. For the Taoist God, the Witch God, and the Demon Lord, these star giants were very happy to see it and they were overjoyed.
At this time, Fang Xuanmu and other five Heavenly Lords also sensed this. They looked at Xiao En, who was sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed, as if isolated from the outside world, and their faces became more worried.
Boom!
Suddenly, there was a thunder in the sky, and many people's hearts trembled. They looked up into the void. At this moment, the sky above their heads seemed to change color, and the endless light of thunder shone like blood.
The whole sky was howling, the universe was rippling, the thunder was fierce, and the sky was burning with fire-like anger, as if it was in a state of annihilation.
"Something's not good!"
The eyes of the five heavenly kings were fixed on the sky. The endless thunder power between heaven and earth involuntarily converged towards the colorful heart. For a moment, the entire colorful heart seemed to be covered by thunder, like a lonely boat in the surging tide, isolated and helpless!
For a moment, the sky was dark and the earth was dark, like a world-destroying thunder coming.
Countless people are trembling and puzzled as to why their colorful hearts, which had just received congratulations from heaven and earth, are now facing destruction!
Boom!
In an instant, an extremely bright light of blood thunder suddenly descended on the colorful heart. The unstoppable will to destroy was suppressed directly from the void. Wherever the blood thunder passed, the void continued to tremble, and an astonishing power of will enveloped it.
Boom!
After the blood thunder, in the sky, the colorful heart was directly wiped out, showing a broken heart shape.
"Sure enough!"
There were sounds of joy from all over the world. This scene seemed to be both expected and expected.
These voices naturally come from the mouths of giants from all walks of life.
The heart of jealousy, how could Heaven allow its existence, and this kind of destruction is just the beginning.
The eyes of the five heavenly kings were fixed on the changes in Sean, who was like a statue.
Click!
As the seven-colored heart in the sky was wiped away from the young boy, the seven-colored light lingering around him was not wiped away, but a blue light slowly retracted into the body.
The five heavenly kings remained silent.
boom! boom! boom! boom!
Everyone saw that four thunders of destruction descended from the sky, and the six-colored heart collapsed one after another. It could also be said to be annihilated.
In the end, only the green and purple lights remained in the heart shape in the sky, forming a crescent moon like a crescent moon.
"The gathering of the Seven Skills is truly a disaster rather than a blessing!"
The Taoist God seemed to have anticipated this incident, and there were not many disturbances, waiting for the destruction to come.
This is the jealousy of heaven. Even the six exquisite orifices will not be destroyed by heaven. Only the seven exquisite orifices will be destroyed if they are not destroyed. If they are destroyed, they will be destroyed.
Therefore, no one who possesses this heart has been able to survive since ancient times.
Giants from all walks of life hold this intention.
Boom!
Two long-brewing destructive lightnings transformed into world-destroying blood pythons, piercing the sky and striking down towards the green and purple crescent moon.
Boom!
